SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND (
			(day = 02 AND hour >= 23)
			OR (day = 03 AND hour <= 00)
		)

	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 23:51:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1

					, unitized_percentage

				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time

			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code

			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'

			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		)

			else 'N'

		, case

			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base

			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg

		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 07 and 08
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 07:36:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	client_ip

WITH

        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-01')

    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'

            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (

                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(

                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))

        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 19 and 20
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 19:33:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::7e01996c660ab2e5737e1c494e6d2e6103ffa023a7d3496f1e682105bfb000dc */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 06 and 07
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 06:30:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           cad_allocation,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2
),
latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
),
latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
),
latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code    = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated  = ca.dt_date
       AND cad.business_date = ca.business_date
       AND cad.as_of_date    = ca.as_of_date
),
latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           TRIM(asset_code)                                  AS asset_code,
           reporting_name,
           investment_name,
           investment_desc_il                                AS investment_description,
           CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code)))              AS model_portfolio_id,
           CONCAT('RD', UPPER(SUBSTR(TRIM(asset_code), 2)))  AS debt_model_portfolio_id,
           investment_agg_il,
           investment_agg_dev_stab_il,
           allocation_name_il,
           programmatic_investment_il,
           al_investment_name,
           investment_type_il,
           il_governance_structure_level_1,
           il_governance_structure_level_2
           investment_stage_current_il,
           country_exposure_il,
           currency_exposure_il,
           market_type,
           country_region_il,
           reporting_currency_il,
           sector_focus_level_1_il,
           sector_focus_level_2_il,
           funding_bucket_il,
           il_investment_structure_level_1,
           il_investment_structure_level_2,
           il_investment_structure_level_3,
           cppib_close_date,
           first_funding_date,
           disposition_date,
           windup_date,
           investment_count_il,
           emerging_market_il, 
           investment_manager_il
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL'
),
latest_yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.as_of_date,
           ild.business_date,
           ild.model_portfolio_id,
           ild.debt_model_portfolio_id,
           ild.reporting_name,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_description,
           ild.investment_type_il,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.investment_stage_current_il,
           ild.country_exposure_il,
           ild.currency_exposure_il,
           ild.country_region_il,
           ild.market_type,
           df2.geographic_focus,
           ild.sector_focus_level_1_il,
           ild.sector_focus_level_2_il,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_2,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,
           ild.investment_count_il,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,
           ac.commitments * fx.rate                           AS commitments_current,
           ac.uncommitted_allocation * fx.rate                AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity                             AS net_invested_equity_base_currency,
           lie.net_invested_equity                            AS net_invested_equity_local_currency,
           df2.commitment                                     AS commitment_base_currency,
           df3.commitment                                     AS commitment_local_currency,
           df2.cad_allocation                                 AS allocation_base_currency,
           df3.allocation                                     AS allocation_local_currency,
           df2.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_base_currency,
           df3.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_local_currency,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency    = ild.reporting_currency_il AND fx.business_date  = ild.business_date AND fx.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,

           cad_allocation,

latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,

           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,

),
latest_cad_invested_equity AS (

           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,

           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
),
latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code    = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated  = ca.dt_date
       AND cad.business_date = ca.business_date
       AND cad.as_of_date    = ca.as_of_date
),
latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (

latest_yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.as_of_date,
           ild.business_date,
           ild.model_portfolio_id,
           ild.debt_model_portfolio_id,
           ild.reporting_name,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_description,
           ild.investment_type_il,

           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,

           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,

           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity                             AS net_invested_equity_base_currency,
           lie.net_invested_equity                            AS net_invested_equity_local_currency,
           df2.commitment                                     AS commitment_base_currency,
           df3.commitment                                     AS commitment_local_currency,
           df2.cad_allocation                                 AS allocation_base_currency,
           df3.allocation                                     AS allocation_local_currency,
           df2.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_base_currency,
           df3.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_local_currency,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency    = ild.reporting_currency_il AND fx.business_date  = ild.business_date AND fx.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date

                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions

),

latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (

           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code    = TRIM(ca.asset_code)

           ild.model_portfolio_id,
           ild.debt_model_portfolio_id,
           ild.reporting_name,
           ild.investment_name,

           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,

           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,

           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,

           df2.commitment                                     AS commitment_base_currency,

           df3.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_base_currency,
           df3.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_local_currency,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency    = ild.reporting_currency_il AND fx.business_date  = ild.business_date AND fx.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date

                              - capital_additions_current

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date

           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,

               ELSE 0

      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad

      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date

           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),

           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,

               WHEN ca.allocation != 0

               ELSE 0

      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad

 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date

 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,

  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date

INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx

latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,

  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date

INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           cad_allocation,

           occupied_area,

latest_local_invested_equity AS (

           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,

latest_cad_invested_equity AS (

           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
),
latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code    = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated  = ca.dt_date
       AND cad.business_date = ca.business_date

           ild.model_portfolio_id,
           ild.debt_model_portfolio_id,

 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           cad_allocation,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2

latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
),
latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,

           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
),
latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code    = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated  = ca.dt_date
       AND cad.business_date = ca.business_date

    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.as_of_date,
           ild.business_date,
           ild.model_portfolio_id,
           ild.debt_model_portfolio_id,
           ild.reporting_name,
           ild.investment_name,

 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency    = ild.reporting_currency_il AND fx.business_date  = ild.business_date AND fx.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date

                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           cad_allocation,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2

latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
),
latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
),
latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code    = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated  = ca.dt_date
       AND cad.business_date = ca.business_date
       AND cad.as_of_date    = ca.as_of_date

latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (

           al_investment_name,

           investment_stage_current_il,
           country_exposure_il,
           currency_exposure_il,

           country_region_il,
           reporting_currency_il,

           il_investment_structure_level_3,
           cppib_close_date,
           first_funding_date,

           emerging_market_il, 
           investment_manager_il
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL'

latest_yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.as_of_date,
           ild.business_date,
           ild.model_portfolio_id,
           ild.debt_model_portfolio_id,
           ild.reporting_name,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_description,
           ild.investment_type_il,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.investment_stage_current_il,
           ild.country_exposure_il,
           ild.currency_exposure_il,
           ild.country_region_il,
           ild.market_type,

           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,

           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,
           ild.investment_count_il,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,
           ac.commitments * fx.rate                           AS commitments_current,
           ac.uncommitted_allocation * fx.rate                AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity                             AS net_invested_equity_base_currency,
           lie.net_invested_equity                            AS net_invested_equity_local_currency,
           df2.commitment                                     AS commitment_base_currency,
           df3.commitment                                     AS commitment_local_currency,
           df2.cad_allocation                                 AS allocation_base_currency,
           df3.allocation                                     AS allocation_local_currency,
           df2.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_base_currency,
           df3.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_local_currency,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency    = ild.reporting_currency_il AND fx.business_date  = ild.business_date AND fx.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date           
),
latest_yardi_deals_with_derived_fields AS (
    SELECT *,
           (
              equity_carrying_value_base_currency
            + unfunded_commitment_current
           )                                                             AS equity_exposure
      FROM (SELECT *,
                   (
                      commitments_current
                    - invested_commitment_current
                   )                                                     AS unfunded_commitment_current 
              FROM (SELECT *,
                         (
                                gross_invested_equity_current 
                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current
                         )                                               AS invested_commitment_current
